To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
fuzzy logic control method can be used for the braking force control of EHB system.
the fuzzy logic controller can be used as a brake force supervisory controller to provide ideal brake forces according to the driver’s braking intention.
a fuzzy logic based EHB system can achieve a better performance than conventional hydraulic braking system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of an EHB system which takes the safety and performance issues into account and is able to provide an optimal braking force according to the drivers' intention.
the development of a FIS-based braking control system which can provide a safe braking performance and is suitable to be implemented in vehicles.
the application of fuzzy logic in the control of EHB systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fuzzy logic controller can be used in the EHB system to improve braking performance.
the proposed system has a great potential to be applied in EHB systems in vehicles.
the proposed EHB control system is able to achieve the desired brake force and the brake pressure in the wheel brake cylinder is maintained at an appropriate level.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a fuzzy logic control method of the EHB system based braking intention pattern identification is a good alternative to the existing EHB systems.
the EHB control system can improve the performance of braking system, enhance the safety, and reduce the cost.
the proposed system can be used in real time applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the FIS Brake Force Controller can effectively provide the ideal brake force to the driver's intention and the PI Controller is able to regulate the wheel cylinder pressure to achieve a smooth braking event.
a fuzzy logic control method of an EHB system based braking intention pattern identification can provide a good performance and can be implemented for the real system.
the fuzzy logic controller is a promising approach to control the EHB system.
